newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures erode to new lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures erode to new lows.

text.p: May 13 - U.S. stock index futures eroded to fresh daily lows with T-bond futures after Atlanta Fed Reserve business activity index rose to 22.1 April from rvsd 8.6 March. June S&P 500s weakened early with bonds after retreating from new all-time peak on Globex at 844.90. Some said stocks could try upside again but wondered whether market overly long now.
